objection.status: error reported by an ordinary grader
objection.quote: The strategy is to mark points at 1/(2n+1), 2/(2n+1), ..., n/(2n+1).
objection.witness: The proposed strategy is refuted even for n=2: marks at 1/5, 2/5 give pieces 1/5,1/5,3/5, and Xiang's single cut halving 3/5 yields pieces 3/10,3/10,1/5,1/5, which pair up, so Liu gets only 1/2 < 3/5.
